semantics.target_rule: Reload targets an exact UserModule definition/instance identity.
semantics.candidate_rule: Changed definition/config/schema is staged and validated before affecting the active instance.
semantics.stop_rule: Owned runtime resources are quiesced/stopped according to module lifecycle.
semantics.reconcile_rule: Reload replaces only source-owned module state/config and preserves unrelated runtime/user state.
semantics.activate_rule: Validated candidate loads/activates through normal lifecycle/dependency/authority checks.
semantics.failure_rule: Failed reload restores/keeps a deterministic prior or stopped recoverable state.
semantics.identity_rule: Reload does not change module/instance identity unless the candidate explicitly declares a new identity.

invariants.rule: UserModule identity, primary type, schema, instance identity and lifecycle state are explicit and never inferred from filesystem location or implementation behavior.
